height_rule_text.value: The R-CP district permits a maximum residential building height of 40 feet above average adjacent grade, or 3.5 stories. The bottom-most story would then be partially above and partially below grade; the portion below grade would not be counted towards the maximum height.

density_rule_text.value: The number of residential units (i.e., density) allowed is determined by dividing the site area by 2,000 and rounding to the closest whole number and calculated to the thousandth place.
density_rule_text.quote: The number of residential units (i.e., density) allowed is determined by dividing the site area by 2,000 and rounding to the closest whole number and calculated to the thousandth place.

special_conditions.text: Rear yard must be at least 30% of lot area or 30 ft.
special_conditions.quote: A minimum rear setback of 30-foot, or 30% of lot is required.

special_conditions.text: At least one side yard must be 5 ft.
special_conditions.quote: On at least one side, a minimum 5-foot side yard setback is required.

special_conditions.text: Front yard follows prevailing setbacks, not to exceed 10 ft.
special_conditions.quote: No front yard setback is required, except where front yard prevailing setbacks apply. In such cases, the front yard prevailing setback can not exceed 10 feet.

special_conditions.text: Properties also in a Historic District Overlay may have additional bulk requirements.
special_conditions.quote: Properties within the R-CP District that are also located within an Historic District Overlay (HDO) are subject to additional or different bulk requirements.
